title: Eleven Minutes and One Room
subtitle: 会议与交流 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 会议与交流（社会服务与人际沟通·会议与协商）
meta: 主题语境：会议与交流（社会服务与人际沟通·会议与协商）　|　核心词汇：conference　|　正文 331 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 conference 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 my mother ① called a conference about a roof that had already leaked twice, and she said the calling was the whole of the repairing. The ② conference, meaning the meeting and not the room, lasted eleven minutes and stayed that length; conference, she said, is the only thing in a building that is judged by how soon it ends.

Every ③ conference in that school had the same long table, and the ④ conference at the end, meaning the one she kept for the parents and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever remembered twice. Conference, my grandmother said, is nine parts table and one part somebody willing to end it; my mother said the ending is the part that fills the minutes.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the conference was the whole of the season, meaning the league and not the meeting. The ⑥ conference, meaning the league and not any of that, is the only thing in a season that everybody belongs to and nobody attends; conference, he said, is either something you call or the only word that means both a meeting and a league. She said the league is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ conference had become a line in a budget, and the budget had become an argument about the table. The ⑧ conference of the whole thing, my mother wrote in September, was one roof and thirty years of ending; conference, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to call one. He said the calling was never mentioned.

The ⑨ conference I remember is the one at the end, which was held in 1984 and is still described as the shortest in the county. A ⑩ conference, my grandmother said in 1986, is the only thing that improves by being ended; every conference, she said, is a league that has agreed to look like a meeting. She said the league was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 会议（指那场会议本身，与那间屋子相对）
C. 固定搭配：call a conference 召集会议
D. n. 会议（指那个学校里每一次）
E. n. 会议（指末尾那一次）
F. n. 联盟；联合会（指体育联赛分区）
G. n. 会议（指预算里提到的那一次）
H. n. 会商；协商（抽象总称）

items.q: called a conference about a roof that had already leaked twice
The conference, meaning the meeting and not the room
the conference was the whole of the season
the conference had become a line in a budget
The conference of the whole thing
A conference, my grandmother said in 1986

answers.why: call a conference 意为“召集会议”，1970 年母亲就一个已经漏过两次的屋顶召集了一次会议。
conference 意为“会议”，指那场会议本身而不是那间屋子，它只开了十一分钟。
conference 指那个学校里每一次会议，每一次都用同一张长桌。
conference 指末尾那一次（她留给家长的那一次），是唯一有人记住过两次的。
conference 意为“联盟、联合会”，父亲说那个联盟就是那个赛季的全部，指的是联赛分区而不是那场会议。
conference 为另一个义项，指体育联赛的分区而不是那场会议，是赛季里人人归属、却无人出席的东西。
conference 意为“会议”，指预算里提到的那一次，到 1978 年这次会议成了预算里的一行。
conference 意为“会商、协商”，母亲九月写道，整件事的协商是一个屋顶三十年的收尾。
conference 意为“会议”，我记得的是末尾那一次，1984 年召开，至今仍被说成全县最短的。
conference 为抽象总称，祖母说一次会议是唯一会因为被结束而变好的东西。
